from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,importlib.metadata as md,json,sys,agentsync
root=Path(sys.prefix).resolve();d=md.distribution('agentsync-local')
assert d.version=='0.3.0a117' and Path(agentsync.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root)
expected=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes());actual={}
for name,digest in expected.items():
 p=Path(d.locate_file(name)).resolve();assert p.is_relative_to(root)
 actual[name]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();assert actual[name]==digest
direct=json.loads(d.read_text('direct_url.json'));assert direct['archive_info']['hashes']['sha256']=='b78a748bea7bbc4885f1d4448ba02e15fa335e6b78e4f189a37b165d0326f672'
print(json.dumps({'members':actual,'direct_url':direct,'origin':agentsync.__file__,'python':sys.version},sort_keys=True))
